investment_strategy: Constructive but volatility-aware AI-core portfolio. With NASDAQ momentum, VIX at 23 signaling choppier tape, and 10Y yields at 4.28% keeping valuations disciplined, we overweight cash-rich AI platforms (MSFT, GOOGL) for durable growth and resilience, and add a smaller satellite in core AI compute (NVDA) to capture the data center/GPU capex supercycle. We size risk conservatively by capping high-volatility exposure at 20%, lean into names with strong earnings beats and positive analyst consensus, and remain mindful of regulatory and export-control risks. Rebalance quarterly or on ±5% deviation from target weights; trim if single-name allocation exceeds target by >7% or if VIX spikes >30.

analysis_summary.market_outlook: Constructive multi-year AI cycle (assistants in devices/apps, data center buildout, rising AI energy needs) but near-term volatility elevated (VIX ~23) with regulatory/export-control headlines and 10Y yields ~4.3%. Favor cash-rich AI leaders and core semiconductor enablers with disciplined sizing.
